code_version: FIRST VERSION of the code (commit 0ce1911, before the defects were fixed)

defects.found: Typing 'nan' as a sale or loan amount crashed the app (HTTP 500 Internal Server Error); 'inf' gave a misleading message.
defects.cause: Python's float() accepts 'nan' and 'inf'. NaN passed every comparison and SQLite stored it as NULL in a NOT NULL column.
defects.fix: New helper parse_number() in database.py rejects values that are not finite numbers.

defects.found: A sale dated 91 days ago (or 01-01-1900) was accepted.
defects.fix: vendor.log_daily_sale() rejects entries more than 90 days old (MAX_BACKDATE_DAYS); FR-VEN-5 updated.

defects.found: Paying an EMI with amount 'nan' marked the installment PAID.
defects.cause: Same as DEF-01: the 'less than EMI' check is False for NaN.

defects.found: Names such as '12345' or a 51-character string were accepted at registration.
defects.cause: The name was only checked for being non-empty.
defects.fix: auth.validate_name(): letters, spaces, dots and apostrophes only, at most 50 characters; FR-AUTH-1 updated.

defects.found: A customer or municipal officer could open any vendor's loan page and see the amount and EMIs.
defects.cause: The /loan/<id> page only required a logged-in user and checked ownership for vendors only.
defects.fix: Only the owning vendor and bank officers may open a loan page (LOAN_VIEW_ROLES in app.py).

defects.found: Paying an EMI of a loan that does not exist, or of another vendor's loan, showed two error messages ('Loan not found | Loan not found').
defects.cause: The error page redirected to the loan page, which reported a second error.
defects.fix: The pay_emi route redirects to the dashboard when the loan is missing or not the vendor's own.
